name: Bingo Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Bingo Software Co., Ltd. provides cloud computing and industry information services in China. It offers BingoAiInfra, an intelligent computing power scheduling cloud platform; BingoInsight, a cloud data lake management platform; BingoFuse, a cloud application support platform; BingoLink, an enterprise collaboration platform; and BingoCloudOS, a cloud operating system with IaaS+ capabilities.
